sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
When we say 'direct carer', we mean an employee that provides hands-on care to people when they are elderly, ill or disabled. You may provide home-based care (in clients' homes) and community based care (assisted living facilities).

This information doesn't apply if you're a participant or nominated representative under the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS). Payments you receive are tax free and you can't claim for expenses for assets paid for by the scheme.
